items.title: Frank Tate interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 17, 2001
items.q: I think his name is John Poole.

ctx.x: Oh yeah, well, she’s nothing if she’s not interesting. And she had a good week though. She had some trouble there, she had a drummer once who quit on Tuesday night, he said — I think his name is John Poole. And he said, “I just can’t stand any more of these two day weeks.” She’d go in and get fired by Tuesday. But she had settled down.
She was a little strung out sometimes, wasn’t she?
